Is there ergative alignment of flagging on first person pronouns?
Comment: The pronouns seem to exhibit a nominative-accusative alignment.
curated_comment: Verified against Svard 2013:26-27 (sec.3.4, ex.37). Pronouns use one NOM series in -da for both S and A (e.g. alda buk-uk 'he sat' [S] vs. sikda ... o-m-ak 'they killed' [A]), so S=A. No ergative split on pronouns and not tripartite. Coding 0 confirmed. Footnote 15 raises but rejects a noun-like (erg-abs) reading of 1SG nara/nadya for lack of direct evidence; uniform 0 across persons retained.
